1| # beacond operations guide
2| 
3| ## Deployment
4| 
5| beacond ships as a single static binary. Run it under a process
6| supervisor (a systemd unit is the reference setup) with the queue
7| database on local disk. Point subscribers at stable DNS names such as
8| `hooks.example.net`, never at ephemeral addresses.
9| 
10| ## Restart procedure
11| 
12| Send SIGTERM and wait. The process stops accepting publishes, then
13| drains in-flight deliveries for a bounded grace period before
14| exiting. Events still queued are picked up on the next start; no
15| manual intervention is needed.
16| 
17| ## Signing secret rotation
18| 
19| Generate a new secret file, install it on producers first, then
20| restart beacond with the new `SigningKeyPath`. Producers signing with
21| the old secret are rejected after the restart, so rotate producers
22| before the relay.
23| 
24| ## Tuning delivery
25| 
26| Failed deliveries back off exponentially with jitter; the exact
27| schedule lives in the relay package. If a subscriber flaps, expect
28| delivery attempts to spread out rather than hammer it.
